mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUIPMENT e JOIN CATEGORY c ON e.category_id = c.category_id
AND c.category_name = #{category}

SELECT c.category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'RENTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rented, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'BROKEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS broken FROM EQUIPMENT e JOIN CATEGORY c ON e.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name

SELECT r.rental_id AS rentalId, r.equipment_id AS equipmentId, e.equipment_name AS equipmentName, r.rental_date AS rentalDate, r.return_date AS returnDate, r.request_status AS requestStatus FROM RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON r.equipment_id = e.equipment_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.rental_id DESC

SELECT e.equipment_name, c.category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS available_count FROM EQUIPMENT e JOIN CATEGORY c ON e.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = #{category} AND e.status = 'AVAILABLE' GROUP BY e.equipment_name, c.category_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY e.equipment_name ASC
SELECT equipment_id FROM EQUIPMENT WHERE equipment_name = #{equipmentName} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY equipment_id ASC LIMIT #{quantity}

SELECT e.equipment_id, e.equipment_name, c.category_name AS category, e.status, e.qr_image_path, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM EQUIPMENT e JOIN CATEGORY c ON e.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EQUIPMENT (equipment_name, category_id, status, created_at) SELECT #{equipmentName}, category_id, 'AVAILABLE', NOW() FROM CATEGORY WHERE category_name = #{category}
mapper.update: UPDATE EQUIPMENT e JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.category_name = #{category} SET e.equipment_name = #{equipmentName}, e.category_id = c.category_id, e.status = #{status}, e.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT category_name FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY category_name
SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY category_name LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
